metadata.description: Golden COLLECTION fixture for Phase 23 (Collections MVP). ONE collection with a small known member set (3 real compounds) under the members_config shape (D-02), plus an 'expected' block with per-member IMP/activity expectations and an aggregate bioactivity heatmap matrix (members x activity-types). The aggregate matrix shape (D-01/D-10) is the contract downstream fan-out + heatmap tests verify. Per-member 'expected' values are illustrative placeholders for the scaffold and are tightened by the plans that compute them (23-02 fan-out, 23-07 charts).
metadata.supersedes_note: Does NOT modify tests/fixtures/golden_compounds.json (the IMP-scoring baseline).
